decisions.coverageKnown: REVE public web exposes the municipality as an operator label. CIDO records a municipal public price for EV charging approved in 2023, but that cited entry is explicitly no longer current.
decisions.blockingReason: A current 2026 numeric municipal charging tariff was not established in the bounded first pass, so the historical public-price record is not promoted.
decisions.resumeCondition: Current municipal public-price text, QR/app tariff, or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: The current official municipal mobility page exposes a dedicated public-EV-charging-points service entry.
decisions.blockingReason: The bounded first pass did not establish a current numeric direct charging tariff from the official municipal page; no value is extrapolated from older metropolitan charging schemes.
decisions.resumeCondition: Current municipal/AMB tariff page, QR/app price, or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: A public local report documents the municipal fast and semi-fast charging station and states that charging was free when commissioned in 2022.
decisions.blockingReason: No current 2026 official municipal numeric tariff was established in the bounded first pass; the 2022 free-service statement is too old to promote.
decisions.resumeCondition: Current municipal tariff/service page, QR/app price, or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.
